title: Capitalisation tables
definition: The company's own record of its owners and the percentages they hold, including any classes of share with different rights. It is requested alongside a shareholder register, and it establishes the distribution of ownership and of control rights, which the register alone does not show.
evidence_to_cite: the capitalisation table, with the date it was produced
the share classes and the rights attached to each
any inconsistency with the shareholder register

sources.citation: Ownership and control evidence, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
